Odoo | Software Developer (Python / JavaScript) | Grand-Rosière (near Brussels), Belgium | Hybrid, 3 days/week in office | Full-time | €10k signing bonus

Odoo is an open-source suite of business apps (CRM, accounting, inventory, payroll...) used by millions. I'm on the Belgian payroll team: Python, an in-house ORM, and real business logic thousands of companies run on. You ship to production fast and code is mostly open source.

Juniors and recent grads welcome. Package includes a company car, meal vouchers and a €10k signing bonus.

Apply: https://www.odoo.com/r/zbNF
